subject.identity_exact: BENCH_BOTTLE_D48_H180-2 ideal rigid maintained frictionless model using conveyor support normal plus three verified 93 mm lateral generator-line contacts

provenance.tool_path: Ideal finite-line rank calculation inside cg.verifier.function-first.lateral-contact-manifold at PR #82 head fd7e5e10ccecca8923558f72655dab0af4365a4d

payload.method: 6-DOF contact constraint rank calculation using the conveyor support-normal row plus two axially separated normal-constraint samples at each verified 93 mm lateral generator-line contact; ideal rigid maintained frictionless contact model
inputs: conveyor support-normal contact from admitted current-pose evidence
interpretation: The finite axial extent of the three verified lateral generator-line contacts adds the independent rotational constraints absent from the earlier sampled point-normal model.
Within the ideal rigid maintained frictionless current-pose model, exactly one instantaneous null mode remains: rotation about the bound bottle wrap axis.
This is a geometric constraint result, not proof that the real unilateral contacts are maintained.
explicitly_not_claimed: The rank result does not establish real tilt restraint unless the lateral contacts are maintained by adequate preload/compliance over the required operating interval.
It does not establish friction, traction, driven wrap torque, force/load capacity, pressure, stiffness, or reaction-path adequacy.
It does not establish interval-wide capture, label-transfer, wrap, release, or reachable-state behavior.
It does not select a mechanism or grant mechanical acceptance.
